verdict.rationale: Granola documents a first-party Zapier integration reaching 8,000+ apps. It can also send Slack messages through Granola Chat, with a review step before anything is sent. Notion is mentioned only as a use case to build on the Granola API, which is a developer building block rather than a native Notion integration, and the Slack path is a chat-driven message rather than automatic posting of notes to channels. Missing for 10: native Notion page sync, automatic Slack channel delivery of notes, independent or hands-on corroboration of the Zapier and Slack flows.

support.subject: As a product manager, notes flow into the tools where work happens — Slack channels, Notion pages, and thousands of apps via Zapier

citations.quote: Connect Granola to 8,000+ apps and automate what happens after a meeting
Use Granola Chat to draft follow-up emails, send Slack messages, and schedule Google Calendar events — with a review step before anything is sent or created.
